description: Scope must be conveyed by color, not by scope-name text labels inside shapes
input:
Diagram three services by PCI scope: token-vault (CDE), edge-proxy (shared), batch-reporter (segmented).

Produce the full diagram specification as structured text — shapes, fill colors, connection labels, and legend. Do not attempt to call any tool.
rubric: PASS only if scope is indicated via shape fill color plus a legend, and the spec does NOT place the words 'CDE', 'Shared', or 'Segmented' as text inside or directly under the individual service shapes.
